messages.content: who were critics of nicolaus copernicus Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced.

message.content: Who opposed the heliocentric model? Many clergy members rejected it. They feared it contradicted scripture. Some astronomers also criticized the mathematics. Was their resistance purely religious? Not entirely; scientific rigor played a role too. How did society react initially? It was largely ignored or mocked. Did Copernicus publish his work before dying? Yes, in 1543. What impact did this have? It sparked a revolution in science.
